t: This is 1 South Audley Street, a nineteenth-century terraced house in Mayfair. It was designed by two architects, George Aitchison and Frederick Pepys Cockerell. Aitchison was a British architect and Royal Academician with a considerable reputation. Cockerell was the second son of the architect Charles Robert Cockerell, and he took from his father a strong interest in French architecture and in sculpture as part of a building. The house stands next to number two, which the same two architects designed.
